description: This file defines a class 'Validations' providing static methods for validating cell addresses and ranges within spreadsheets, including converting, extracting, and formatting cell references in a PHP spreadsheet library.

classes.name: Validations
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for validating and converting cell addresses and ranges in spreadsheet worksheets.

methods.name: validateCellAddress
methods.description: Validates and formats a single cell address, accepting string, array, or CellAddress object, returning the address in a standardized string format.

methods.name: validateCellOrCellRange
methods.description: Validates and formats a cell or cell range, accepting various input types, converting simple references to range format if necessary.

methods.name: validateCellRange
methods.description: Validates and formats a cell range, handling string, array, or AddressRange object, converting ranges like 'A:C' or '1:3' to full cell references.

methods.name: definedNameToCoordinate
methods.description: Converts a named range or coordinate string to an appropriate cell reference, resolving defined names within a worksheet context.
